audit_identity.scope: Selected failures and controls; not a random deployment sample or fresh-current-build baseline.

baseline_warning: An output1.2.1 build is a separate reference, not the audited 1.4.0.dev0 deployment. No captured run is supplied here.

grading.1: source-verified topical context, insufficient diagnostic/key content
grading.2: source-verified answer-bearing passage; hit does not imply a complete answer
grading.source_matching: Same PDF hash and all normalized passage anchors; require overlapping physical page when row provenance is available. Legacy anchor-only matches are counted explicitly. Table-of-contents or heading-only hits do not satisfy branch/diagnosis anchors.

acceptance.control_policy: All three known prose controls and both historical-intent controls must retain relevant hits; no universal recency boost. Additional source labels must be frozen before ranking changes.
acceptance.crowding_policy: Report unique/dominant document fractions and repeated same-source-table rates. Table continuity can be relevant: these diagnostics are not optimization targets alone. Unknown legacy table provenance is not a zero repetition rate.
acceptance.improvement_policy: Compare the same frozen manifest against a separately identified reference and candidate. Require improvement on the independent sampled set before claiming ranking improvement; run controls without regression. No ranking tuning is authorized by this manifest.

independent_sampling.selection_type: purposive source-first supplement; not random, blind, or representative
independent_sampling.original_materialized_sample: Retained unchanged, insufficient: 5 selected units/2papers; 3 source-scorable units/1paper. This supplement does not replace that sample retroactively.
independent_sampling.limits: Purposive selection from five gold papers based on source observations. No retrieval ranks examined. Not a probability sample, deployment prevalence, exhaustive relevance, or independently human-graded benchmark.
